policy: Exactly three autonomous pinned math-god root sessions. Parallel research uses Task subagents, never additional Kortix roots.
replacement_protocol: Confirm the registered session is irrecoverably dead rather than idle or temporarily failed.
Fetch and preserve every unique commit from its branch.
Create exactly one replacement pinned to math-god with the same lane prompt.
Rename it, update this registry and the matching trigger session_id in one commit, and push.
Fire the trigger twice and verify both deliveries target the replacement before retiring the old session.
